Recreational Programs Floor Tumbling & Obstacle Skills Classes Operate September 2026–June 2027 A floor-focused recreational gymnastics program for athletes who want more time to develop their gymnastics skills on the floor. Gymnasts work through structured progressions in body control, handstands, rolls, cartwheels, jumping and landing technique, strength, flexibility and coordination, progressing toward increasingly challenging floor and tumbling skills as they are ready. Unlike our regular recreational gymnastics programs, this class does not rotate through vault, bars and beam. Training is focused on floor skill development, with conditioning and obstacle-based stations used to support strength, power, agility and safe gymnastics progression. Recommended for ages 7+. No previous gymnastics experience required.
